martin2011.endpoint: approach to call speaker among responding females

between_conditions_independent_fisher_di.assumption: Only if cohorts are independent; individual reuse or pairing not identifiable from aggregate counts.

martin2011.notes: Original paper reports significant preference; printed counts do not reproduce printed p values under standard exact binomial test. No claim that a difference of significance is evidence for interaction. No nest-only condition, chemical diffusion not independently quantified, no actual copulation/fertilization endpoint. PDF screenshots failed; text and figure extraction agree.

lin2000.note: Previously recorded v0.9. Egg-white foam resemblance and real nest differ in more than optics; no pure visual causality. Do not pool different comparisons or assume independent flies.

optical_material.observation: pale fresh foam often develops blue-green pigmentation over hours to days
optical_material.note: Protein absorbance at 680–700 nm and 360 nm subsidiary band are not intact foam reflectance. Camouflage is a proposed function, not demonstrated. Historical species complex identity as published.

butterfly_analogue.note: Beck et al. 1999: conspicuous Eurema decoys attracted papilionids and pierids at puddling baits; lycaenids did not show the same decoy response. Decoys are not foam; shape, color and chemical effects not fully isolated. Previously recorded.

decision: Test heterospecific visual cue and subsequent acceptance separately; prioritize direct behavioral manipulations and calibrated optical measurements. No confirmed Pieridae foam visual response or fertilization.
